knowledge:
- key_parameters: nodelist=Path to a tab-delimited file defining pedigree nodes, generation times, and methylome availability ;; edgelist=Path to a tab-delimited file defining ancestral connections (edges) between nodes ;; cytosine=The sequence context of cytosines to analyze (e.g., "CG", "CHG", "CHH") ;; posteriorMaxFilter=The posterior probability threshold for filtering high-confidence methylation state calls (typically 0.99) ;; sampling.design=The experimental design for plotting pedigrees ("progenitor.endpoint", "sibling", "progenitor.intermediate", or "tree") ;; p0uu=Initial proportion of unmethylated cytosines in the founder ;; eqp=Equilibrium proportion of unmethylated cytosines ;; eqp.weight=Weight given to the equilibrium constraint (1 for selfing systems, 0.001 for somatic systems) ;; Nstarts=Number of starting values for optimization (at least 50 is recommended for real analyses) ;; Nboot=Number of bootstrap iterations for standard error estimation (at least 50 is recommended)
- alternatives: methimpute=An HMM-based methylation state caller for WGBS data, which produces the exact file structure expected by AlphaBeta. Other callers can be used if their outputs are manually reformatted to match methimpute's structure.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have multi-generational DNA methylation data (WGBS, RRBS, epiGBS, or array-based) from mutation accumulation lines (selfing, sibling-mating, or clonal) or somatic lineages (such as branches of long-lived trees) and want to calculate rates of spontaneous methylation gains/losses and test if selection is acting against these epimutations.
- pitfalls: Incorrect pedigree topology specification will bias rate estimates; users should always visually inspect pedigrees using plotPedigree. Outlier samples can heavily influence the regression; users must inspect the divergence vs. delta.t plot to identify and remove outliers. Using too few Nstarts (e.g., < 50) may lead to local optimization sub-optimal solutions.

workflows.name: selfing_epimutation_analysis
workflows.intent: Estimate germline epimutation rates and test for selection in selfing-derived mutation accumulation lines.
input: methylome_files (cytosine-level or region-level methylation state files in methimpute format, referenced in nodelist.fn)
workflows.stages: 1. Build the pedigree and calculate pairwise divergence values using buildPedigree. ;; 2. Generate diagnostic pedigree plots using plotPedigree. ;; 3. Plot divergence values against delta.t to inspect for outliers. ;; 4. Fit the neutral epimutation model using ABneutral. ;; 5. Fit selection models (against gains or losses) using ABselectMM and ABselectUU. ;; 6. Fit the null model (no epimutation accumulation) using ABnull. ;; 7. Compare models using FtestRSS to select the best-fitting model. ;; 8. Perform bootstrap analysis on the best-fitting model using BOOTmodel to obtain standard errors. ;; 9. Plot the final model fit using ABplot.
workflows.code:
output <- buildPedigree(nodelist = sampleFile, edgelist = edgesFile, cytosine = "CG", posteriorMaxFilter = 0.99)
plotPedigree(nodelist = sampleFile, edgelist = edgesFile, sampling.design = "progenitor.endpoint", output.dir = out.dir, plot.width = 5, plot.height = 5, aspect.ratio = 1, vertex.size = 6, vertex.label = FALSE, out.pdf = "MA1_1")
pedigree <- output$Pdata
dt <- pedigree[, 2] + pedigree[, 3] - 2 * pedigree[, 1]
plot(dt, pedigree[, "D.value"], ylab = "Divergence value", xlab = expression(paste(Delta, " t")))
p0uu_in <- output$tmpp0
output <- ABneutral(pedigree.data = pedigree, p0uu = p0uu_in, eqp = p0uu_in, eqp.weight = 1, Nstarts = 2, out.dir = output.data.dir, out.name = "ABneutral_CG_global_estimates")
outputABselectMM <- ABselectMM(pedigree.data = pedigree, p0uu = p0uu_in, eqp = p0uu_in, eqp.weight = 1, Nstarts = 2, out.dir = output.data.dir, out.name = "ABselectMM_CG_global_estimates")
outputABselectUU <- ABselectUU(pedigree.data = pedigree, p0uu = p0uu_in, eqp = p0uu_in, eqp.weight = 1, Nstarts = 2, out.dir = output.data.dir, out.name = "ABselectUU_CG_global_estimates")
outputABnull <- ABnull(pedigree.data = pedigree, out.dir = output.data.dir, out.name = "ABnull_CG_global_estimates")
out <- FtestRSS(pedigree.select = file1, pedigree.null = file2)
Boutput <- BOOTmodel(pedigree.data = inputModel, Nboot = 2, out.dir = getwd(), out.name = "ABneutral_Boot_CG_global_estimates")
ABplot(pedigree.names = ABfile, output.dir = getwd(), out.name = "ABneutral", plot.height = 8, plot.width = 11)

workflows.name: somatic_epimutation_analysis
workflows.intent: Estimate somatic epimutation rates and test for selection in clonal, asexual, or somatic systems (such as trees).
input: SOMA_nodelist.fn (tab-delimited file of somatic pedigree nodes/branchpoints)
SOMA_edgelist.fn (tab-delimited file of somatic pedigree edges)
somatic_methylome_files (leaf or tissue methylation state files in methimpute format, referenced in SOMA_nodelist.fn)
workflows.stages: 1. Build the somatic pedigree and calculate pairwise divergence values using buildPedigree. ;; 2. Generate diagnostic somatic pedigree plots using plotPedigree. ;; 3. Fit the neutral somatic epimutation model using ABneutralSOMA. ;; 4. Fit somatic selection models using ABselectMMSOMA and ABselectUUSOMA. ;; 5. Perform bootstrap analysis on the best-fitting somatic model using BOOTmodel. ;; 6. Plot the final somatic model fit using ABplot.
workflows.code:
outputTree <- buildPedigree(nodelist = treeSamples, edgelist = treeEdges, cytosine = "CG", posteriorMaxFilter = 0.99)
plotPedigree(nodelist = treeSamples, edgelist = treeEdges, sampling.design = "tree", output.dir = out.dir, plot.width = 5, plot.height = 5, aspect.ratio = 1, vertex.size = 8, vertex.label = FALSE, out.pdf = "Tree")
Tree_p0uu_in <- outputTree$tmpp0
pedigree.Tree <- outputTree$Pdata
outputABneutralSOMA <- ABneutralSOMA(pedigree.data = pedigree.Tree, p0uu = Tree_p0uu_in, eqp = Tree_p0uu_in, eqp.weight = 0.001, Nstarts = 2, out.dir = getwd(), out.name = "ABneutralSOMA_CG_global_estimates")
outputABselectMMSOMA <- ABselectMMSOMA(pedigree.data = pedigree.Tree, p0uu = Tree_p0uu_in, eqp = Tree_p0uu_in, eqp.weight = 0.001, Nstarts = 2, out.dir = getwd(), out.name = "ABselectMMSOMA_CG_global_estimates")
outputABselectUUSOMA <- ABselectUUSOMA(pedigree.data = pedigree.Tree, p0uu = Tree_p0uu_in, eqp = Tree_p0uu_in, eqp.weight = 0.001, Nstarts = 2, out.dir = getwd(), out.name = "ABselectUUSOMA_CG_global_estimates")
Boutput <- BOOTmodel(pedigree.data = inputModelSOMA, Nboot = 2, out.dir = getwd(), out.name = "ABneutral_Boot_CG_global_estimates")
ABplot(pedigree.names = ABfilesoma, output.dir = getwd(), out.name = "ABneutralSOMA", plot.height = 8, plot.width = 11)
